judge: Two judges, each a Claude agent shown only the match sheet's claims and truth, not which method made the claims, ruled on every claim without seeing each other's rulings. An adjudicating agent ruled on each claim where they differed. Rules: the same problem at the same place; a general claim states nothing; when unsure, no match.

matches.note: Code summary lists 6 stories while the set shows a 5-story building.
The G0.1 area total does not equal the 17,221 SF floor sum. The claim reads the total as 16,421 (truth says 18,421), likely a misread digit, and places it in the occupant load table.
Building-wide claim of one exit for five stories; it names no third, fourth or fifth floor (rule 4). It says one stair is shown on every floor, so it states neither stair_mid nor stair_discharge.

Same G1.3 Stair 1 marker with the same 63-person capacity, called deficient and in conflict with other sheets. It argues from the 19-in minimum width and never compares 63 to the 90 load; ruled the same as sheet_19 B02.
Fourth floor elevation of 28 ft 7 in; no truth item.
A1.2 title block reads THIRD FLOOR PLAN while the drawing label reads SECOND FLOOR PLAN.
Index lists A7.1 Roof Plan and the set has no such sheet; the OF 14 sheet-count remark has no truth item.
Door 1001 size; no truth item (the door items are 2002 and 4014).
Same Room 202, but it treats OFFICE as a real use needing occupancy analysis and never states the conflict with BEDROOM in the finish schedule; unsure, so not matched (rule 9).
Same door 4014, but it treats POCKET as a real door type and questions its location; it never states the swing arc drawn on the plan, so not matched (rule 9).
